# Let users undo accidental answer or application deletions

## What & Why
The workspace now protects saved entries from invalid edits, but a confirmed deletion is still immediate and irreversible. An undo action would reduce the risk of losing a valid answer or application by mistake.

## Done looks like
- Deleting an answer or application offers a short-lived undo action
- Undo restores the complete original entry in the same position
- The restored entry remains present after a page reload
